Quantify lag contributions to the cumulative DLNM effect

Source: R/lag_contribution.R
lag_contribution.Rd

Decomposes the cumulative DLNM effect into relative contributions of individual lags based on daily lag-specific effects.

Usage

lag_contribution(daily_df, lag_window = NULL, absolute = TRUE)

Arguments

daily_df

Output from summarise_effects(scale = "daily"). Must contain columns: lag, effect.

lag_window

Optional vector of length 2 specifying the lag interval c(lag_start, lag_end). If NULL, the full lag range is used.

absolute

Logical. If TRUE (default), contributions are calculated using absolute effects to avoid sign cancellation.

Value

A data.frame with lag-specific contributions to the cumulative effect.
